description: statussink/v1 — Reactor: uploads a resource's rolled-up status JSON to an object store when a subscribed lifecycle transition fires. This CRD only REGISTERS the reactor + its config schema; which kind/transition it runs on is a reactor_bindings subscription, not baked in here. The endpoint (BOOTSTRAP) and prefix (WORK-TIME) come from the kind's providerconfig.

endpoint.description: Object-store endpoint dialed once at startup (BOOTSTRAP). A missing/invalid value fails Setup; the kind stays pending until a default config supplies it.

prefix.description: Key prefix uploaded objects land under (WORK-TIME, live-editable).
